evidence: Paper analyzes dietary effects on mosquito development using Kruskal-Wallis and Wilcoxon rank-sum tests, comparing means across five diet treatments. Methods section (2.5): "Comparisons of physiological features (mean weights, wing lengths and nutrients) for each diet were performed by Kruskall-Wallis test followed by pairwise scoring using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test." All inference based on classical non-parametric tests, not random forest impurity importance.
